config.description: The wheel-odometry stream is suppressed, removing the dead-reckoning fallback's main input. Combined with a GNSS outage this is the case the safety design exists for: there is no validated fallback, so the correct response is to stop rather than to trust an inertial-only solution.

faults.label: fix lost while odometry is down
